style.Keywords: Monospace-only, near-black surfaces, 9-16px type anchored on 11-12px with an 18px section heading, maximum rows per viewport, resizable split panes, sticky table headers, CSS-div bar charts, semantic status classes, collapsible sections, keyboard-operable rows, zero decorative chrome, dark-mode only, operator-facing
style.Primary Colors: Four-tier near-black ramp: page #0a0a0f, card #111118, hover #1a1a24, elevated #16161e; borders #1f2937 (subtle) / #374151 (control) / #334155 (divider)
style.Secondary Colors: Text #e5e7eb primary, #d1d5db control, #94a3b8 soft, #7d8a99 muted — #7d8a99 is the floor, because near-black surfaces cannot carry a dimmer grey at 4.5:1; accent blue #60a5fa, info cyan #38bdf8, success green #34d399, warning amber #fbbf24, danger red #f87171; hue families in use: gray, amber, sky, red, emerald, yellow, blue, fuchsia, cyan, rose, green, orange, slate, indigo, violet, lime; bridge status tones green #4ade80, amber #fde047, red #f87171
style.Effects & Animation: Hover 120ms ease on background/border/color, layout and panel resize 180ms, bar width 300ms, 2s opacity pulse for stale/connected status dots, sweep gradient for pending latency bars, filter brightness(1.2) on group hover; every animation is a class so prefers-reduced-motion can disable it, never an inline style; 1px inset and hairline rings serve as borders; elevation shadows run 0 2px 6px to 0 24px 64px on cards, buttons, toasts, panels, popovers, dropdowns, drawers and modal overlays
style.Best For: Operations and monitoring dashboards, log and session timelines, token/cost accounting, agent run consoles, latency and queue inspectors, developer-facing internal tools
style.Do Not Use For: Landing pages, marketing sites, consumer-facing apps, light-mode products, touch-first mobile, anything needing a brand personality
style.AI Prompt Keywords: Dense dark ops dashboard; near-black surfaces, monospace 11-12px body, compact rows, sticky headers, resizable panes, CSS bars, semantic status dots, AA contrast, visible focus, Escape overlays, reduced motion, no hero/light mode.
style.CSS/Technical Keywords: background:#0a0a0f; font-family:'Cascadia Code','Fira Code',Consolas,monospace; font-size:11px; padding:2px 8px; border-radius:6px; border:1px solid #374151; thead th{position:sticky;top:0;background:#111118}; flex-basis + cursor:col-resize handle; ::-webkit-scrollbar{width:6px;height:6px}; :focus-visible{outline:2px solid #60a5fa}; @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce){animation-duration:0.01ms}; transition:background-color 120ms ease; display:flex;flex-direction:column-reverse for stacked bars; box-shadow:0 0 0 1px ring as border, larger blur for elevation
style.Implementation Checklist: ☐ Surfaces drawn from the four-tier ramp #0a0a0f/#111118/#1a1a24/#16161e, with any variant declared as a token rather than inlined, ☐ Body text is 10-12px via text-[10px], text-[11px] and text-xs; text-sm and text-lg appear in headings, KPI values and dialog close controls, never text-base, ☐ Padding is anchored on px-2/py-1 for rows and badges; px-3, px-4, p-3 and p-4 carry page chrome, section cards and dialogs, never space-y-4, ☐ Radius 2-16px, 999px pill or 50% dot, no rounded-xl, ☐ Every text colour measured at >=4.5:1 against its own surface, ☐ Monospace applied to numerals so columns align, ☐ Status carried by dot plus label via semantic classes, never colour alone and never framework utility names, ☐ Charts built from CSS divs, no chart library, ☐ Split panes resizable and width persisted, ☐ Table headers sticky, sortable ones focusable with aria-sort and Enter/Space, ☐ Clickable rows and cards reachable by keyboard, ☐ Visible :focus-visible ring, never outline:none without a replacement, ☐ Escape closes every overlay and dropdown, ☐ All animation guarded by prefers-reduced-motion, ☐ Icons are inline Unicode glyphs, emoji and inline SVG, no icon font and no SVG sprite, paired with a text label so meaning does not rest on the glyph, ☐ No hero and no marketing section
